verdict.rationale: Datadog provides vendor-maintained Agent, OpenTelemetry support, Kubernetes autoscaling/monitoring, cloud integrations, and an integrations directory of 1,000+ tools covering hosts, containers, K8s, and cloud services (datadog-docs-2, datadog-docs-17, datadog-docs-28, datadog-intdir-1/2). Community feedback corroborates real-world use across APM/infra correlation despite some UX complaints unrelated to instrumentation coverage. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation specifically of Kubernetes/cloud agent setup ease, and no direct evidence of agent version/coverage breadth beyond docs listing.
